script:
# GFX architectures are auto-detected from the artifact directory
# (populated by --expand-family-to-targets in the fetch step).
# KPACK_SPLIT_ARTIFACTS is auto-detected from therock_manifest.json.
prefix=()
if [[ "${NORMAL_VALIDATION}" == "true" ]]; then
  prefix=(python build_tools/profile_build.py --output output/normal-validation/profile --)
fi
"${prefix[@]}" python ./build_tools/packaging/linux/build_package.py \
  --dest-dir "output/packages" \
  --rocm-version "${ROCM_VERSION}" \
  --artifacts-dir "output/artifacts" \
  --pkg-type "${NATIVE_PACKAGE_TYPE}" \
  --version-suffix "${PACKAGE_BUILD_SUFFIX}" \
  --build-variant "${BUILD_VARIANT}"
scope: Exact actual runner-resolved script, ANSI/timestamp prefixes removed. No workload execution in host fixtures.
